messages.content:
Classify candidate taint SOURCES for a Java CWE-22 (path traversal) static analysis.
A source is a method call whose RETURNED value can carry data that an external
attacker controls and that may be used to name a file or resource path, such as
names read from an archive or upload, request parameters, environment or
command-line input. Values the program computes or chooses itself, or that a
trusted caller supplies, are not sources. For each candidate decide
source | not_source | unknown. Cite at least one supplied call-site ID (K...)
showing how the value is obtained or used. Do not decide from the method name
alone; if the supplied code is insufficient, answer unknown. Labels, versions
and fix locations are unavailable.
Return ONLY JSON: {"sources":[{"id":"C01","decision":"source|not_source|unknown",
"reason":"at most 30 words","evidence":["K1"]}]}. Return every candidate exactly once.
